PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
Notice under Section 38(1)

I, hereby notify that the list of polling stations of Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha specified in the notice under Section 38(1) ofthe Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2051/03 of 26.12.2017related to Galle Administrative District is revised as given in the Schedule below :
K. U. CHANDRALAL,Returning Officer, Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Galle District,04th day of September, 2019.
